_comment: Warders guild layer for 3s. Warders have no GP1/GP2 pools, so the gp1 bar is STS (their superpower, N uses per reset) and the gp2 bar is Favor/Boil (secondary powers sharing one usage count) - fed by katmud_lib/warder.py from the prompt, gs/score and GMCP Guild.Info. MIP/FFF is gone mud-side (2026-09-15). Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).
Favor/Boil is not on the prompt; it updates on gs/score (or GMCP boils, documented but not yet seen).

Attack: BAREBONES attack. Properly: 'consider <mob>' FIRST (chance to reveal a Darkfriend), then 'engage <mob>' (or 'engage current' if already fighting). Hunt can't do the consider step yet - revisit.
